::: {#bio}

# Welcome to <span class="name-highlight">WFRC Analytics</span> documentation.

This portal provides comprehensive documentation for the Wasatch Front Regional Council's analytical models and tools, including the Travel Demand Model, Real-Estate Market Model, and Bike Demand Model. Access technical documentation, validation reports, model components, and interactive tools that support evidence-based transportation planning and decision-making across the Wasatch Front region.
